title: Agent memory: what does Copilot remember about a user, and who can switch it off?
summary: The documented control paths and API calls are supported, but several stronger conclusions are not. In particular, an enabled tenant control does not establish that every user already has inferred memories, and Microsoft does not establish that the tenant and Copilot Studio controls operate independently. The statement that switching memory off deletes nothing also needs to account for chat-history details being deleted after 30 days.

claims.fix: Replace the bullet's bold lead with 'Switching the control off does not delete custom instructions or saved memories.' Keep the following sentence explaining that chat-history details are deleted after 30 days; it is an exception to the current absolute lead.
